body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes Calendar/ListView UX regressions in ObjectUI by removing redundant creation UI, restoring calendar event click propagation from ListView, and internationalizing the ListView record-count footer.

**Changes:**
- Remove the calendar-internal “New event” button by no longer wiring `onAddClick` into `CalendarView`.
- Forward renderer props in `ObjectCalendarRenderer` (while omitting `data/loading`) so ListView-provided handlers like `onRowClick` can reach `ObjectCalendar`.
- Internationalize the ListView record count via new i18n keys across locales and a safe translation wrapper with English fallback.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 16 out of 17 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds `@object-ui/i18n` as a workspace dependency for plugin-list. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Adds `useListViewTranslation()` fallback + uses i18n keys for record count display. |
| packages/plugin-list/package.json | Adds `@object-ui/i18n` dependency to plugin-list. |
| packages/plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx | Updates `ObjectCalendarRenderer` to forward props (excluding `data/loading`). |
| packages/plugin-calendar/src/calendar-view-renderer.tsx | Stops passing `onAddClick` into `CalendarView` (removing internal create button). |
| packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx | Disables `CalendarView` “New event” button by setting `onAddClick` to undefined. |
| packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts | Adds `list.recordCount` / `list.recordCountOne` translations in all locale packs. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the related i18n and calendar fixes as completed. |
</details>
